nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Welcome to the Library. Every book here is catalogued, cross-referenced and, on one occasion, struck by lightning.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Borrow whatever you like. Return it on time, and we shall get along splendidly.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: Struck by lightning... in a library. I'm not going to ask.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: Library rules: no shouting, no spells, and no asking me what I'm reading.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: ...It's about ancient ward circles, if you must know. Fascinating stuff. Now shush.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: Oh! Sorry, I was looking up. The sky's clearer here than anywhere I've ever lived.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: If you're up late, come to the fountain. The water holds the stars perfectly still.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: Stars. Yeah. I've had about enough of those for one day.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Did you hear? Someone missed the entire orientation ceremony. The whole thing!

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Professor Kepler went looking for them at the forest gate. Apparently they turned up looking like they'd seen a ghost.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: ...I am not telling them that was me.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: The training dummies in here have been through a lot. Mostly because of me.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Come back once you've learnt a spell or two. I could use someone to practise with who isn't made of straw.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: Shh. If you stand still long enough, you can hear the brook and the lanterns humming together.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: I come out here to think. Campus is lovely, but it's loud.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: A forest with humming lanterns. Sure. Totally normal.
